series.title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
series.description: Captain Christopher Pike commands the USS Enterprise on exploratory missions before James T. Kirk's captaincy, alongside Una Chin-Riley and Spock. The crew meets unfamiliar civilizations, confronts the Gorn and repeatedly tests Starfleet ideals while Pike lives with foreknowledge of the accident awaiting him.
series.collectionScope: SceneSense includes a Season 00 SPECIAL EDITION placeholder for a custom re-edit of Discovery Season 2 centered on Pike, Spock and the Enterprise; its episode count is TBD. Seasons 04 and 05 are non-scored UHD Blu-ray placeholders until matching collection media is held.

series.title: Stargate Atlantis
series.description: An international expedition travels through the Stargate to the lost Ancient city of Atlantis in the Pegasus Galaxy. Led by Elizabeth Weir and later Samantha Carter and Richard Woolsey, Sheppard's team explores Ancient technology, forms alliances with human worlds and wages a long war against the Wraith, Genii, Replicators and Michael's hybrids.

series.title: The Adventures of Brisco County Jr.
series.description: Harvard-educated bounty hunter Brisco County Jr. crosses the changing American West in pursuit of John Bly's outlaw gang after they murder his marshal father. Joined and challenged by fellow bounty hunter Lord Bowler, lawyer Socrates Poole and singer Dixie Cousins, Brisco repeatedly encounters experimental technology and the mysterious Orb, hints of the future intruding on the frontier.

series.title: The Blue Racer
series.description: A lightning-fast blue snake repeatedly turns hunger, romance and wounded pride into elaborate slapstick schemes. His earliest and most persistent target is the karate-trained Japanese Beetle, before the chase expands to birds, bears, dragons and other creatures equally capable of ruining the Racer's plans.

series.title: The Class
series.description: A surprise gathering reunites a group of people who shared the same third-grade class twenty years earlier. Ethan's failed romantic gesture becomes the starting point for a loose adult ensemble whose friendships, marriages, breakups and improbable accidents keep pulling the former classmates back into one another's lives.
